instruction: Add a `--tz` option to the `datekit` command-line tool that converts parsed dates to the given IANA time zone before printing, for example `datekit parse 2026-09-27T10:00:00Z --tz Asia/Tokyo`. Without `--tz`, output stays as it is today. Document the option in `README.md`.

criteria.text: --tz converts to the named zone, including across a daylight-saving change.
